title: Identifying potential targets in endothelial to mesenchymal transition-mediated atherosclerosis using bioinformatics and machine learning.
authors: Hou, Zhengjun; Chen, Sihan; Cui, Yuliang; Ma, Qinfeng; Chen, Jiandong; Shu, Kunxian
one_liner_zh: 该文用生物信息学和机器学习识别动脉粥样硬化中EndMT相关关键基因，虽含TF网络但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Endothelial to mesenchymal transition (EndMT) is a key driver of atherosclerosis (AS). This study integrated multiple RNA transcriptomic and single-cell transcriptomic datasets to identify shared gene expression signatures between EndMT and AS. METHODS: GEO expression profiles were analyzed via differential expression, weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), and functional enrichment analyses. A Random Forest model evaluated key genes, validating their expression and diagnostic performance. Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) further assessed their expression patterns, and a Transcription Factor (TF)-mRNA-miRNA regulatory network. RESULTS: Fifteen overlapping genes were identified, from which six candidates were screened through a Protein-Protein Interaction (PPI) network and validated in vitro. The application of a Random Forest model identified two key hub genes, CCL5 and IL1B, which were significantly upregulated. Their diagnostic Area Under the Curve (AUC) was >0.7 when assessed separately and increased to >0.85 in a combined model. Three shared TFs (NFKBIA, NFKB1, RELA) of the Nuclear Factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB) pathway were identified, highlighting its central role in disease progression. CONCLUSIONS: CCL5 and IL1B are key genes potentially regulating EndMT-mediated AS via inflammatory pathways including Nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain-like (NOD-like) receptor, Tumor Necrosis Factor (TNF), and NF-kappaB signaling, offering promising diagnostic and therapeutic targets for AS.
abstract_zh: 背景：内皮-间质转化（EndMT）是动脉粥样硬化（AS）的关键驱动因素。本研究整合了多个RNA转录组和单细胞转录组数据集，以识别EndMT与AS之间的共享基因表达特征。方法：通过差异表达、加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）和功能富集分析对GEO表达谱进行分析。随机森林模型评估关键基因，验证其表达和诊断性能。单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）进一步评估其表达模式，并构建转录因子（TF）-mRNA-miRNA调控网络。结果：共鉴定出15个重叠基因，通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络筛选出6个候选基因，并在体外验证。应用随机森林模型识别出两个关键枢纽基因CCL5和IL1B，其表达显著上调。单独评估时，其诊断曲线下面积（AUC）>0.7，在联合模型中增至>0.85。鉴定出核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）通路的三个共享转录因子（NFKBIA、NFKB1、RELA），突显了该通路在疾病进展中的核心作用。结论：CCL5和IL1B是通过炎症通路（包括核苷酸结合寡聚化结构域样（NOD样）受体、肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）和NF-kappaB信号通路）潜在调控EndMT介导AS的关键基因，为AS提供了有前景的诊断和治疗靶点。
